title: Bill Belichick and North Carolina blow big lead, lose 28-20 at Clemson

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bill Belichick and North Carolina blow big lead, lose 28-20 at Clemson
sources.description: Bill Belichick appeared to be on the verge of his biggest win as North Carolina's head coach today at Clemson, but his team fell apart late in a 28-20 loss.
